outputs.description: adding their name + info to a google spreadsheet and filling out the relevant information (name, class, major, affiliation, interests, other)

mustShow: Google Sheet containing rows with name, class, major, affiliation, interests, other for identified sisters

contentExpectations: Cover each of the six named sororities at MIT: Alpha Chi Omega, Alpha Phi, Delta Phi Epsilon, Kappa Alpha Theta, Pi Beta Phi, and Sigma Kappa
For each sorority, identify the sorority's MIT chapter website found via searching 'sorority name MIT'
For each sorority, identify the sisters/members page on that website
From each sisters page, identify seniors (class of 2026) and juniors (class of 2027)
For each identified senior/junior, record name, class, major, affiliation, interests, and other relevant information in the spreadsheet
Where a sorority's website or sisters page or class-year info is unavailable or cannot be found, note this as a credible blocker rather than fabricating entries
